justification: The only correspondence is the most generic one possible: both surfaces present a living being whose head is articulated with eyes and a nose. A shows two horned animals in profile with elaborately patterned fleece, curling horns and fine linear infill, while B is a single frontal, blocky humanoid figure rendered with extremely reduced schematic features and no animal attributes or repeated motifs, so relationships, arrangement and conventions of depiction share nothing distinctive.
